paper.title: Using a deep-learning approach to infer and forecast the Indonesian Throughflow transport from sea surface height
paper.conclusion_note: The source motivates the proposed study, but the proposal is an AI interpretation rather than an author-reported result or established research gap.

claims.extracted_value: Test tail-sensitive losses with independent observational evaluation for ITF extremes.
claims.locator: PDF pp. 5-7: paragraph preceding Figure 5; Figure 5B-C caption; observational-validation paragraph and Figure 8 caption; discussion of persistent peak bias
claims.evidence_summary: The CNN persistently underestimates peak ITF transport despite more extreme samples and MAE/MSE trials; its satellite-SSH inference is also compared with INSTANT, MITF, and IX1 observations and differs chiefly at peaks and valleys.
claims.audit_note: The primary paper documents the problem, but a tail-sensitive loss is a source-grounded AI proposal, not an author-reported result or established novelty. Retain AI_INTERPRETATION and NOT_VERIFIED.

unresolved: The proposal's comparative value and novelty require a broader literature review; this claim audit does not establish them.
